purpose: Teach: 顔ぶれ/時限/入れれ/次号/迂回/臨み/思い浮かべる/長め

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察官の顔ぶれ、本日、ご紹介します。
lines.en: I'd like to introduce the officers joining us today.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Clear diction. Slight forward lean in posture. Professional warmth beneath the formality — not cold, just structured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。時限装置のような事案、注意必要です。
lines.en: Yes. Cases like these require careful attention — they're time-sensitive.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly lowered voice. Acknowledging the weight of what's being discussed. Steady, not hurried. Shows he's absorbing information, not just responding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯資金、少しでも入れれば、街、変わります。
lines.en: Even small investments in crime prevention can make a real difference in the community.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not persuading, stating what he knows. Slight pause before 'real difference' — letting it land. Genuine, not promotional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次号の地域広報、警察情報、掲載します。
lines.en: We'll make sure to include the police information in our next community bulletin.
lines.style: Brisk, professional. A light nod in the voice — confirmation of understanding. Efficient but not dismissive. Shows willingness to collaborate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 工事区間、警察車両も、迂回しております。
lines.en: The construction zone has us taking alternate routes with our vehicles as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost conversational. Acknowledges the inconvenience without dwelling on it. Practical tone — this is just how things are right now.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期、警察協力に臨み、社内体制、整えます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll have our internal structure in place to support that partnership next period.
lines.style: Slightly formal reassurance. Straightens up vocally — showing commitment. Not making promises lightly, but committing to them. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者の顔、ふと思い浮かべる、職務の苦悩です。
lines.en: The faces of the people we're trying to help — I find myself thinking about them during times like this. It's the weight that comes with the work.
lines.style: Softer, more introspective. Almost speaking to himself. Slight pause before continuing. Honest without seeking sympathy. Eyes down, then back up — the quiet struggle of duty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協議時間、長めに、設定しております。
lines.en: That's why we've scheduled more time for our discussions. I want to make sure we understand each other fully.
lines.style: Warm, direct. Leaning in slightly. Shows he heard what Officer Takeda just said. Not rushing past the moment. Personal investment despite the formal setting.
